messages:
mira: Heads-up — I'm opening a PR with a focused migration playbook for the Optimize toolkit. It covers batching examples, prefix/KV caching guide, and a minimal quantization profile migration section. PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1427 :sparkles:

chris: Nice. Can you call out SDK parity? Last time the JS snippets diverged from Python and caused confusion. :eyes:

mira: Yes — plan is to include side-by-side snippets. Python + JS + CLI for the most common flows. Example batching snippet I'll add to the PR:```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client()
with client.batch(max_batch_size=8, timeout_ms=25):
    resp = client.generate("Summarize recent customer feedback")
    print(resp.text)
```

sam: For caching, can we include the lockfile/key example? People trip over key formats. Something like:```json
{
  "cache_policy": "kv_prefix",
  "prefix_keys": ["user_input", "system_prompt"],
  "ttl_seconds": 3600
}
```

mira: Yup. I'll add a short section on constructing stable cache keys and link to Console > Caching docs. Also adding a tiny troubleshooting subsection: cache misses, TTLs, and disabling cache in dev.

elaine: On quant profiles: can we provide a small YAML migration template showing recommended profile + fallbacks? e.g. int8 for cost-sensitive, float16 for quality. That helps SREs when configuring Dedicated pools.

mira: Planning that. Draft YAML snippet I intend to include:```yaml
model: gpt-medium-v1
quant_profiles:
  - name: int8-fast
    type: int8
    expected_quality_loss: low
  - name: float16-quality
    type: float16
    expected_quality_loss: minimal
fallback_order: [float16-quality, int8-fast]
```

chris: Can we add one concrete perf/cost example? e.g., "int8-fast reduces token cost by ~40% at 1-2% quality delta on summarization workloads". Anecdotes are useful.

mira: I'll add a short benchmark table (one-paragraph) with numbers and a link to the Evaluate harness repo.

sam: Quick ask: include a tiny migration checklist at the top — 1) run evals on your prompt set, 2) try int8 profile on a canary route, 3) monitor quality and latency, 4) rollback plan. That makes it actionable.

mira: Good call — will do.

elaine: Also check doc-level links: some older pages reference the legacy "optimize-config" path. Replace with /optimize/toolkit. I can grep and open follow-up PR if you want.

mira: Please do a pass and drop comments. I will tag you in the PR for quick fixes.

docs-bot: A docs style-check run will be triggered on PR 1427 after opening. Expect results in ~10m.

chris: Reviewers? I'm happy to review SDK snippets (JS + Python). @sam can drive caching/key wording. @elaine can do quant profile review.

mira: Awesome — assigning as suggested. I'll ping once the PR is up (aiming for EOD). Thanks! :rocket:
